description: The harness memory ledger fragments per git worktree: oh-path anchors the memory dir to the calling worktree root, MEMORY.md is gitignored, and ensure-memory-file.sh seeds an empty stub there — so every build session reads a blank ledger and writes lessons that die with the branch. Anchor the `memory` name to the main worktree, correct the docs that call the tier 'local-per-instance', and guard it with one rejection-verified probe. Authoritative reference: .oh/tasks/768-portable-memory-tier/prd.md; disproof evidence: findings.md. Target: upstream/development (mifunedev/openharness), issue #768.

userStories.title: Anchor oh-path memory to the main worktree

acceptanceCriteria: `bash .oh/scripts/oh-path memory` run from a linked worktree prints the SAME absolute path as the same command run from the main checkout

The change applies to the name `memory` ONLY. `bash .oh/scripts/oh-path crons|evals|tasks|context` run from a linked worktree still resolve against that worktree's own root — unchanged from before the patch
An absolute MEMORY_DIR or an absolute harness.yaml paths.memory is still honored verbatim; only RELATIVE values change which root they measure from
The env → harness.yaml → default precedence order is untouched

Resolution degrades safely: outside a git repository, or when `git` is absent, the script falls back to the existing repo-root anchor and exits 0. `oh-path` runs under `set -eu`, so every git call must not abort the script
From the main checkout the resolved path is byte-identical to the pre-patch output, so a fresh clone with no linked worktrees is unaffected
`shellcheck .oh/scripts/oh-path` is clean (no new findings vs. the pre-patch baseline)
userStories.notes: PASS. memory matches the main checkout from a worktree; crons/evals/tasks/context/worktrees stay branch-scoped; absolute MEMORY_DIR honored verbatim; precedence untouched. Degrades to the previous root and exits 0 on git exit-128, on git printing a non-directory, and outside a repo. GAP: shellcheck is not installed in this container, so the shellcheck criterion was not run and is not claimed.

userStories.title: Guard the anchor with one rejection-verified probe
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want a probe that goes red when the anchor regresses so that the fix cannot be silently undone.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly ONE new file: `.oh/evals/probes/memory-dir-shared-across-worktrees.sh`, executable, with the id/tier/source/desc header and the 0-pass / 1-REGRESSION / 2-SKIPPED exit contract every probe in .oh/evals/probes/ uses

The probe creates a REAL linked worktree via `git worktree add --detach` and invokes THAT worktree's own copy of oh-path. It must not copy oh-path to /tmp or invoke the main checkout's copy — either resolves a bogus root and proves nothing

It asserts the worktree-resolved memory dir equals the main worktree's memory dir, resolving the main root via `git worktree list --porcelain` (NR==1), never by assuming $ROOT is the main checkout — the probe may itself run from a linked worktree
It reads git topology and paths ONLY. It never reads MEMORY.md content, .pi/, node_modules, or any untracked state, so a fresh CI clone and this worktree produce the same verdict (the PR #760 defect)
It cleans up: `git worktree remove --force` plus `git worktree prune` on a trap EXIT, and it creates or truncates no file under any real .oh/memory

REJECTION PROOF, recorded in evidence.md with real pasted output: against a copy of oh-path with the anchor reverted the probe exits non-zero, and the failure is attributed to THIS assertion — show the per-assertion failure line count, confirm other assertions report 0, and confirm the detection disappears when this assertion alone is stripped
It exits 2 (SKIPPED), not 1, on an honest environment gap: no git, not inside a repo, or `worktree add` refused
userStories.notes: PASS. One probe. Rejection run against the unfixed script fails on exactly (a) and (b) with (c)'s five name checks and (d) at zero; pass run green; swapping only the script inside one fixed worktree flips the result, attributing the exit to the anchor block. Topology and paths only, env overrides cleared, vacuous-pass guard present. Suite: 100 pass / 0 regression / 3 unrelated skips.
